releaseNotes: Marks charts now dynamically round the Y-axis floor down to the nearest ten below the lowest score: 73% gives 70–100%, and 94% gives 90–100%.
Resources replaces category and subject dropdowns with separate horizontal button panels, including counts, selected-state highlighting and combined filtering/search.
Long filter rows scroll on narrow screens and preserve keyboard focus. Full-mark charts retain a valid scale, and extra credit can extend the upper bound.
No extra LMS requests. Existing credentials, settings, student history, private completion status and saved resources are preserved.
